name: San Ho Won

menus.name: Prix fixe House Menu
menus.note: For the whole table, at least two guests; no changes or dietary swaps. Grilled meats and other dishes can be added.

bookingOpens: Online through SevenRooms. Tables open at 10am each day, 29 days ahead. Book a 'Prix Fixe House Menu' reservation for the set menu, or a general or counter reservation to choose between à la carte and the set menu on arrival.
cancellation: Deposits are refunded in full up to 24 hours before the booking; after that there are no refunds or credits, including for guests who don't come. Tables are held for 15 minutes.
walkIns: Walk-ins are welcome at the communal counter from 5pm, best for one or two people. Some bookings for one or two are also seated at the counter.
groups: Parties of 9 to 16 use the private room, bookable one to three months ahead; parties of 17 or more can ask about a buyout.
children: Count children in the party size. If a child won't eat the full House Menu, book a general reservation and order à la carte.
duration: Tables are held for two hours (two and a half for parties of five or more).
